output.one_liner: ClickUp unifies tasks, docs, goals, and chat in a single platform for team collaboration and project management.

auth.notes: Personal API tokens and OAuth 2.0 both supported for authentication

evidence.snippet: For personal use, authenticate with your personal API token
For apps or integrations that other people use, use the OAuth flow
ClickUp uses the authorization code grant type
Add the token to the header: Authorization: {personal_token}. This is also needed.

access.notes: API and MCP available on all plans including free tier; OAuth app creation requires workspace owner/admin

evidence.snippet: ClickUp's MCP Server is available on all plans
A new ClickUp account is automatically set up with a Free Forever Workspace
Only Workspace owners or admins can create OAuth apps

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Rate limits vary by plan and MCP add-on status; rolling 24-hour limits apply

evidence.snippet: Build integrations and apps with our Public API

overview_evidence.snippet: ClickUp unifies tasks, docs, goals, and chat in a single platform, allowing teams to plan, organize, and collaborate across projects with customizable workflows
